about.body: The AJ-V6 is Jaguar's petrol V6 engine, produced from 2001 to 2009. It's a Ford Duratec-derived unit, appearing in the S-Type across both 2.5-litre and 3.0-litre capacities. The same engine family was also used in the X-Type (AJ25 and AJ30 variants), though the S-Type carries the broadest application of the AJ-V6 nameplate in the Jaguar range.

byModel.body: The S-Type carried the AJ-V6 across its full production run from 2001 to 2008, in both 2.5 V6 and 3.0 V6 forms. As one of the earlier 2000s Jaguar models, the S-Type's petrol V6 option remains a common candidate for rebuild work when high mileage or extended service intervals have taken their toll.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ-V6 spans 2.5-litre and 3.0-litre capacities across the S-Type, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model and year, which we do by registration. A 2.5-litre AJ-V6 isn't a direct swap for a 3.0-litre unit without the corresponding ECU and ancillaries - we confirm your exact spec before any work begins.
